summary: The comment urges preservation of the E-Rate program to ensure schools and libraries can maintain and modernize technology infrastructure, emphasizing the cost and impact of losing funding on educational access and continuity.

claims.argument: Loss of E-Rate funding would force districts to choose between technology infrastructure and other educational priorities
claims.evidence_quote: For VCUSD, the loss or significant reduction of E-Rate funding would make it extremely difficult to afford the necessary upgrades required to keep our Category One and Category Two infrastructure functioning, secure, supported, and up to date.

filer_raw: Winston Crump - Vallejo City Unified School District
